messages:
noah: Draft of the launch blog is up: https://docs.redwood/launch/post-alpha. Can people do a quick pass on: 1) 1-line exec summary, 2) benchmark claim + footnote, 3) hero + footer CTAs, 4) inbound routing (NA vs EMEA) by EOD? :pray:

gina: On it. Quick Q about benchmarks 12: are the numbers from Dedicated internal runs or a public baseline? need hardware + quantization details for the footnote.

noah: Good call. Results are from Dedicated alpha (H100S, int8 path) measured Apr 2026. I'll add a methodology link and test window. Current claim reads: 'up to 4x lower token cost vs baseline fp16 serving.' Open to safer phrasing.

rachel: Legal quick-pass: prefer: 'up to 4x in internal performance benchmarks (see methodology)'. Add measurement dates, hardware + baseline, and avoid words like "guarantee" or "save". Also change any "our tests" language to 'internal performance benchmarks'.

amir: Ops/growth notes: CTA ideas - primary: 'Book a technical demo', secondary: 'View benchmark details', footer: 'Request trial access'. Routing: demo -> SDR by region, benchmark -> marketing nurture. For EMEA route to EMEA SDR 08:00-18:00 CET, otherwise fall back to NA SDR. Pasted CSV for ops mapping:
```
region,segment,demo_type,preferred_window
NA,SMB,Live-demo,09:00-11:00 ET
NA,Enterprise,Tech-deep,13:00-17:00 ET
EMEA,SMB,Recorded+book,09:00-12:00 CET
EMEA,Enterprise,Live-deep,13:00-17:00 CET
APAC,Any,Recorded+calendar,Weekdays SGT
```

hubspot-bot: Reminder: Embargo active until 2026-04-08T17:00:00Z. Please set `embargo: true` and remove public links until release. :lock:

gina: Exec one-liner suggestion: 'Redwood Inference: predictable, production-ready LLM inference at lower unit cost.' Shorter and product-focused.

rachel: Legal approves the footnote once updated. One micro-edit: prefer 'internal performance benchmarks' everywhere for consistency.

noah: Thanks all. Plan: 1) swap in Gina's one-liner, 2) update benchmark footnote per Rachel and add methodology link, 3) lock CTAs and demo routing, 4) handoff to design + ops. Final check by 17:00 UTC and mark ready-for-design if no blockers. :white_check_mark:
